t_log_subtitle: Connect your store with one click to the strongest delivery and payment partners in Algeria and the Arab world to run your business efficiently.
t_faq_q1: Do I need programming or design experience to use the platform?
t_faq_a1: You don't need any programming or design experience at all. We have designed the platform to be extremely simple and easy. You can create your store or a single-product landing page with one click and start selling immediately.
t_faq_q2: How does artificial intelligence help me increase sales?
t_faq_a2: The AI analyzes your product picture and writes high-converting marketing copies in local dialect or standard Arabic that attract customers and motivate them to buy. It also generates ad images matching your marketing campaigns to increase CTR.
t_faq_q3: Can I connect my own custom domain to my store?
t_faq_a3: Yes, absolutely! The platform allows you in the paid plans (Merchant and Pro plans) to connect your own custom domain (e.g., mystore.com) to establish your brand identity professionally.
t_faq_q4: Does the platform support advanced ad tracking pixels?
t_faq_a4: Yes, the platform supports advanced pixel tracking integrated with Conversions API automatically for Facebook and TikTok without writing a single line of code, ensuring 100% of conversion and purchase data reaches your ad manager and avoiding cookie blocking.
t_faq_q5: How are orders delivered to shipping companies from the store?
t_faq_a5: Through direct integration with shipping companies like Yalidine and others, the order is registered automatically in your shipping company account once confirmed in the SOUQ AI dashboard, allowing you to print the label (Bordereau) and start shipping immediately.
